transcript_before_isolation:
Mr. Vice President, Mr. Speaker, members of the Senate of the House of Representatives,
yesterday, December 7, 1941, a date which will live in infamy.
The United States of America was suddenly and deliberately attacked by naval and air forces of the Empire of Japan.
The United States was at peace with that nation and at the solicitation of Japan.
transcript_after_isolation:
Mr. Vice President, Mr. Speaker, members of the Senate, of the House of Representatives,
yesterday, December 7, 1941, a date which will live in infamy.
The United States of America was suddenly and deliberately attacked by naval and air forces of the Empire of Japan.
The United States was at peace with that nation and at the solicitation of Japan.
